title: Personal Cognitive Garden Update v0.1
description: A proposed or reviewed update to a human-owned, goal-directed cognitive garden. Agents may propose updates; human or governance review decides what becomes durable state. Not every session is developmental; this schema records whether and how the interaction compounds human skill capital.

garden_update_id.description: Stable identifier for this proposed garden update.

transition_id.description: Optional LS transition identifier that produced or reviewed this update.

source_session_id.description: Session or interaction from which the update was derived.

source_artifacts.description: Optional artifacts that support the update, such as traces, summaries, PRs, reports, or messages.

proposed_by.description: Agent, model, tool, council, or human that proposed the update.

model_contribution_signal_id.description: Optional link to the model contribution signal that helped generate this update.

session_development_class.description: Classification of whether the source session primarily compounded human capability or served another purpose.

claim.description: The proposed graph claim or update in human-readable form.

evidence.description: Evidence snippets or references supporting why this update was proposed.

confidence.description: Optional proposer confidence. This is advisory and must not replace review.

development_effect.description: Human capital compounding assessment. Records whether the interaction increased the person's capacity to act, not merely whether it produced useful text.

is_developmental.description: True if the update plausibly increases a human skill, judgment, execution capacity, or reusable development asset.

human_skill_delta.description: Skills, capabilities, or judgment areas this session may improve.

capital_effect.description: How this update may increase the person's durable capability, portfolio, reputation, judgment, or execution leverage.

practice_needed.description: Concrete follow-up practice or action needed to turn the insight into durable skill capital.

compounding_score.description: Advisory estimate of compounding potential. This is not a psychological truth claim.

requires_human_review.description: True when the update affects personal goals, identity, memory, obligations, reputation, access, skill capital, or durable graph state.

review.description: Human or governance review result. Required before durable graph state is changed.

durable_state_allowed.description: Whether this update is allowed to become durable graph state after review.

external_action_allowed.description: Whether this update may trigger external action. Safe default is false.
